tasks.short: Read job orders and inspect workpieces for procedures and materials.

steps.what: Read job orders and the procedures and materials required.
Then inspect workpieces to determine those work procedures.

tasks.design: The coating worker reads the job order as a document and inspects the workpiece in person to decide the procedure and the materials. Both acts stay with that person. Image pass or fail and recipe arithmetic in the group digest cover other occupations, and this task has no second entry of the order.
tasks.previous_blocker: The procedure depends on the piece in front of the worker, not on a rule that is the same for every order.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest's automate bullets cover defect percentages, etching time, and image pass or fail for other occupations in this group. They do not cover reading a job order or inspecting a workpiece to choose a procedure, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: A procedure that ignores a flaw or a material the piece will not take means the article is recoated or scrapped.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing the actual workpiece and judging which procedure and materials it needs.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The coating worker still reads the order and still inspects the workpiece.

reach.role: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
reach.task: Judge a coated article after the coating worker has finished it
reach.learn: Which procedure and which materials the coating worker chose for this piece.

evidence.claim: Reading a job order and inspecting a workpiece to choose procedures and materials stays with the coating worker. Image inspection in this group digest is for other tasks.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the coating worker reads the job order and inspects the workpiece in the shop. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If the order is missing, the worker still asks the supervisor and inspects the piece. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether some shops also write the chosen procedure after the inspection. That writing is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this worker write the chosen procedure into a second record, or only read the order and inspect the piece?

already_counted.description: Reading the order and inspecting the workpiece both remain.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. Reading the order and inspecting the workpiece are the work, and no second entry is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and mix coating ingredients to the specification.

steps.what: Select ingredients to prepare coating substances according to specifications.
Mix coating substances using paddles or mechanical mixers.

tasks.design: The coating worker selects ingredients against the specification and mixes them with a paddle or a mechanical mixer at the bench. That selecting and that mixing stay with the worker. Recipe arithmetic in the group digest is for etching time on other tasks, and it does not replace this mix.
tasks.previous_blocker: The batch is right only when the worker has selected these ingredients and mixed them until the coating is uniform.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest's automate bullets cover defect percentages, etching time, and image pass or fail for other occupations in this group. They do not cover selecting ingredients or mixing a coating with a paddle or a mixer, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong ingredient or a mix that is not uniform shows up as a bad coat and rework of the article.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing the ingredients for this specification and knowing when the coating is mixed.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The coating worker still selects the ingredients and still mixes them.

reach.role: Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
reach.task: Set a spray pass from a coating the worker has mixed
reach.learn: Which ingredients were selected and how the batch was mixed.

evidence.claim: Selecting ingredients and mixing a coating with a paddle or a mechanical mixer stays with the coating worker. Recipe arithmetic in this group digest is for other tasks.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the coating worker selects and mixes ingredients at the bench. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If the specification is missing, the worker still follows the written specification on the bench. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether some shops weigh the batch and write the weights. That writing is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this worker write mix weights into a second record, or only select and mix the coating?

already_counted.description: Selecting the ingredients and mixing the coating both remain.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. Selecting the ingredients and mixing the coating are the work, and no second entry is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reading orders, inspecting workpieces, selecting ingredients, and mixing coatings stay with the coating worker. The week stays at the bench. No decision right moves.

skills_to_grow: Reading a job order against the workpiece
Choosing the procedure from the piece in front of them

role.ambitious_version: The coating worker still reads the order, still inspects the workpiece, still selects the ingredients, and still mixes the coating. A model does not choose the procedure or mix the batch.
